publication_scope: Selected career facts and practice prompts authorized for a public, no-sign-in app on 2026-09-27. Specific workspace disclosure holds remain excluded. Original source files stay private.

cards.title: Developing people at GovCIO
cards.source_label: Dated candidate statement: GovCIO supervision and mentoring, September 20, 2026
cards.guardrail: Keep scope, four-person cohort, personal contribution, and attribution separate. Do not invent employer records.
cards.practice_prompt: Reconstruct one real coaching example: the need, your actions, the employee's actions, and the evidence of change.
cards.follow_up: Which parts of the result can you attribute directly to your support, and which belong to the employee?

facts.text: I managed up to 24 direct reports.
facts.boundary: Peak supervisory scope; not an average, FTE count, or number of functions.

facts.text: Members of my team earned three separate master's degrees—one in Finance and two in Project Management—and another team member earned a PMP certification.
facts.boundary: Four-person credential cohort remains separate from up to 24 reports. Does not establish sole causation or documentary verification.

cards.notice: This is not an official interview question.

cards.title: NATTC mentorship scope
cards.source_label: Dated candidate statement: NATTC mentorship, September 20, 2026
cards.guardrail: The attested number is scope. No achieved outcome is inferred by this card.
cards.practice_prompt: Recall one actual qualification or career-development conversation and explain what you personally did.
cards.follow_up: What outcome can you support without attaching an unrelated command total?

facts.text: As a Navy Chief I was responsible for the mentorship of approximately 52 Sailors.
facts.period: NATTC Navy Chief tenure; statement dated 2026-09-20
facts.boundary: Navy mentorship population only; not GovCIO reports, not a claim of 52 direct reports.

cards.notice: This is not an official interview question.

cards.title: Curriculum quality participation

cards.practice_prompt: Describe one actual curriculum review issue, the evidence you examined, and how you handled the review handoff.

facts.period: Instructional Systems Designer period described in September 20, 2026 review

cards.title: PMP: from credential to judgment
cards.source_label: PMI certificate copy: PMP award and printed dates
cards.guardrail: PMP is not evidence of a PgMP, SAFe credential, or an employer outcome.
cards.practice_prompt: Choose a real program decision and explain how planning, risks, stakeholders, and benefits affected your choice.
cards.follow_up: Which decision is demonstrated by your actual experience rather than by holding a credential?

facts.text: The PMI certificate records the award of Project Management Professional (PMP) to Dustin S. Ford on 21 August 2024, with printed expiration 21 August 2027.
facts.boundary: Historical certificate fact; no live registry check or current-standing assertion.

cards.title: HR education and talent-program thinking
cards.source_label: UWF digital credential copy: MBA with Human Resources Management Emphasis
cards.guardrail: Education does not establish ownership of an enterprise HR performance cycle or calibration program.
cards.practice_prompt: Connect one idea you actually studied to a hypothetical performance-cycle program. Label the application as a proposal.
cards.follow_up: What would you need to learn about the employer's process before applying that idea?

facts.text: The University of West Florida conferred the Master of Business Administration with Human Resources Management Emphasis on Dustin Stephen Ford on 4 May 2024.
facts.boundary: Credential copy; embedded signature was not independently validated. Degree is MBA with HRM emphasis.

cards.title: Master Training Specialist foundation
cards.source_label: NATTC designation copy: Master Training Specialist
cards.guardrail: The designation supplies a foundation; the transfer or adoption example must come from an actual story or be labeled hypothetical.
cards.practice_prompt: Recall one instructional judgment you can substantiate, then explain how it would inform manager enablement.
cards.follow_up: How would you check whether learning transferred into workplace behavior?

facts.text: NATTC Pensacola designated Dustin Ford a Master Training Specialist after he met the program requirements.
facts.boundary: Historical Navy designation, not a civilian professional license or institutional accreditation.

cards.title: AI learning with an honest boundary
cards.source_label: ISPI completion certificate copy: AI4PI Journey
cards.guardrail: A proposal remains a proposal. Do not turn training completion into production experience.
cards.practice_prompt: Explain one concept you personally learned and propose a low-risk way to evaluate an AI-supported learning workflow.
cards.follow_up: What evidence and privacy controls would you require before claiming an improvement?

facts.text: An ISPI AI for Performance Improvement certificate records Dustin Ford's completion of the AI4PI Journey on March 31, 2026.
facts.boundary: Program completion only; no duration, assessed proficiency, AI engineering mastery, or workplace implementation is established.

cards.title: Doctoral study as a learning foundation
cards.source_label: August 2026 unofficial UWF transcript: doctoral coursework in progress
cards.guardrail: Keep academic preparation, personal research, and professional outcomes distinct.
cards.practice_prompt: Describe a performance problem as a researchable question and identify what evidence would distinguish a training problem from another barrier.
cards.follow_up: Which part is knowledge from study, and which part have you demonstrated at work?

facts.text: The August 2026 unofficial UWF transcript records 36 doctoral credits earned through Summer 2026 in Instructional and Performance Technology, with Fall 2026 courses listed in progress and no awarded doctorate.
facts.period: August 2026 record; earned credits through Summer 2026
facts.boundary: Sanitized extract of the governed summary. Does not establish degree completion, candidacy, ABD, enrollment after that period, or completion date.

cards.title: Operating BEAT: personal concept
cards.source_label: Dated candidate correction: Operating BEAT ownership and lifecycle, September 20, 2026
cards.guardrail: Never use this as an implemented-work STAR story. No internal framework content or source document is published.
cards.practice_prompt: If relevant, explain the concept as a personal design idea and propose what a future evaluation would need to test.

facts.text: Operating BEAT is Dustin Ford's personally owned concept or framework. It is not GovCIO property and has never been actualized or piloted.
facts.boundary: Ownership statement is user testimony, not legal proof. No application, implementation, deployment, testing, pilot, adoption, or realized result may be claimed.

cards.title: Tool familiarity versus demonstrated depth

cards.practice_prompt: Select one named tool. State the task you personally performed, the output you created, and the decision it supported.
cards.follow_up: Which tools can you demonstrate today, and which require a practice exercise or current access check?
